meta.note: The repository has no stylesheets, fonts or marks yet. Status names, severity order, answer words and copy rules come from the docs and backend/app/contracts; every visual value is new. Revised Nov 9, 2026: a plain business-tool look with neutral solid surfaces, outlined buttons, a stamp for Possible conflict, and a sidebar app shell. Nov 9, 2026: interface font switched to Geist and Geist Mono.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: App background: the sidebar and the space around panels.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, cards, the top bar, the viewer's document page.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, row hover, wells, the coverage bar's track.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Panel borders and hairlines between rows. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, disabled button outlines, the dashed outline of the agent's content. At least 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface and every -tint fill. Also the outline of every neutral button.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, column headers, sidebar section labels, the agent's label. At least 4.5:1 on every surface and -tint in both themes.

tokens.name: ledger
tokens.usage: The brand, used very sparingly: the focus ring and the Approve family. Links and the active sidebar item are ink. Never a status, and not a button color.

tokens.name: ledger-tint
tokens.usage: Reserved. The selected row and the active sidebar item use paper-sunken instead, so green never reads as approved.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px outline 2px outside the control. Green, so it never reads as a button outline.

tokens.name: approve
tokens.usage: Approve and Confirm buttons: outline, label and check. Teal-leaning and darker than conflict in light, so it parts from the red for people with red-green color blindness.

tokens.name: approve-tint
tokens.usage: Fill inside Approve and Confirm buttons.

tokens.name: reject
tokens.usage: The Reject button's outline, label and x. Just the red: the same as conflict.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlighter yellow behind a quoted passage. Reserved for citations: nothing else is ever yellow. Text on it is on-highlight.

tokens.name: highlight-active
tokens.usage: The passage the viewer is scrolled to, or the one under the pointer.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on highlight and highlight-active, in both themes.

tokens.name: highlight-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of the approximate box the agent draws on a photo or scan. Always paired with a 2px dashed ink outline, since the box is an estimate.

tokens.name: conflict
tokens.usage: The red. Possible conflict's badge text, outline and diamond, its stamp on a charge's details, and the Reject button's outline, label and x. Text on every surface and conflict-tint.

tokens.name: conflict-tint
tokens.usage: Possible conflict badge fill, the Reject button's fill, a Possible conflict reason line, a contradicts answer.

tokens.name: needs-human
tokens.usage: Needs a human: badge text, 1px outline and ring, and the waiting marker on suggestions. Text on every surface and needs-human-tint.

tokens.name: needs-human-tint
tokens.usage: Needs a human badge fill, an unsure answer, the header of a suggestion waiting for the accountant.

tokens.name: missing
tokens.usage: Missing evidence: badge text, 1px outline and dashed ring, which stands for something not on file. Text on every surface and missing-tint.

tokens.name: missing-tint
tokens.usage: Missing evidence badge fill and reason line.

tokens.name: complete
tokens.usage: Evidence complete and a supports answer: text, 1px outline and dot. Blue, not green, so it never depends on hue alone to differ from Possible conflict.

tokens.name: complete-tint
tokens.usage: Evidence complete badge fill and a supports answer.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Geist: crisp, neutral and made for interfaces. Dense by default. Turn on tabular figures for every amount and date column.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Sediment Microbiome Survey of Example Bay
styles.usage: The evidence report's cover and the closeout view's title. One per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The top bar's page title and a charge's name in its detail panel.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and section headings, in sentence case.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Work done after the grant's end date, Jan 31, 2026.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Amounts and the fact a card states.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Bucket badges, column headers, field labels. Sentence case, always.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, sources, page numbers, attribution lines, sidebar section labels.

groups.name: Evidence
groups.note: The serif is used only for text quoted from evidence, so source words never look like interface words.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: The end date of the period of performance for this award is changed from January 31, 2026 to January 31, 2027.
styles.usage: Quoted passages from evidence, set on highlight. Never paraphrase inside this style.

groups.name: Figures

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Ledger line IDs, invoice references and award numbers, exactly as the source writes them.

groups.note: Geist Mono, the matching mono, for IDs only.

spacing.note: 4px base. Ledger rows breathe at space-3; cards pad at space-4.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Mark-to-word gap inside a badge; between a date and its separator.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge side padding; gap between buttons; between a fact and its quote.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of ledger rows and history entries.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gutter between table columns.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards in a column; page side padding on small screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections; page side padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of the evidence report's sections; above a page title.

radius.note: Small and consistent. Nothing is a bubble.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, highlight marks, sidebar items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the viewer.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Count chips in the sidebar.

shadow.note: Flat: panels are set apart by rule borders. Only what floats casts a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, the viewer when it opens over the page.

size.note: Fixed sizes the app shell and components share.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The left sidebar.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: The top bar above the main area.

tokens.name: badge-width
tokens.usage: Minimum width of every bucket badge, so the four boxes line up at one size in tables and the summary.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons inside panels (Approve, Reject, Confirm) and sidebar items.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Top bar buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a charge row.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for reasoning, status text and quoted passages.
